text: Inject was cheap enough to keep feeding /vitafeed. New FEED_BACKLOG queue parks brain seed + compact memory files on disk so the vita brain can log/file/prove growth without agentic AI. Drain: /vitafeed enqueue seed → /vitafeed backlog → /vitafeed next → confirm|override (VITAFEED_PAID still gates send; thrift prefer ≤4 chunks/item, hard max 24). Desk GET /vita/feed-backlog. Never invents hashes. Mother brain untouched.

hypothesis.note: Backlog of data feeds vita brain while Cursor/agent is off; pending→sealed counts prove growth.
